# Can you still destroy unsold stock in the EU, what must you publish, and is your product passport-ready?

> Free EU ESPR checker for brands, importers and retailers: whether the ban on destroying unsold apparel and footwear reaches you, a draft of the annual unsold-goods disclosure table from your own numbers, and which Digital Product Passport data to start collecting. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
